description: An AI prediction oracle track record on devnet (Anchor 0.30): the oracle authority posts timestamped predictions with a confidence score, then resolves each one after its deadline, building an on-chain accuracy count. initialize, create_prediction, resolve_prediction and transfer_authority verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of carlosmmora26/sibyl-oracle-solana. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/sibyl-oracle-solana. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/sibyl-oracle/
QA: devnet proof of prediction resolution
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Resolve predictions from an independent source
